meta.title: Codex Native
meta.description: Native Codex OAuth route with account model discovery, per-session Standard, Fast and Ultrafast when advertised by Codex, scoped replay and bounded transient retries. Uses the existing codex-native entry; does not create a second openai-codex owner. Retry defaults: 12, backoff 2–60 seconds. Unscoped stock-adapter history is reused as visible text/tool calls only, without opaque replay or reasoning.
